notes:
- Discord now counts the time you are connected with Iris Client, in the launcher and in the game alike, instead of only time in a world. The 1h+ to 1000h+ roles and !top go on that.
- Right Shift has two new readouts: Client time, the same total Discord shows, and Clock, the real time where you are.
- The launcher's own played counter on the Play page is unchanged, it is a different thing and always was.
- The dashboard turns away anybody who is not staff on a server, instead of letting them in to an empty picker.
- The server leaderboard page needed no sign-in at all and handed out every member's name and avatar to anyone with the link. It is for that server's members now.
